defects.expected: Watch::tick must create restart adapters at 2000, 4000, 10000, 40000, and 160000 ms; a third successful start must restore Up with restarts=3.
defects.observed: The factory count stayed at its initial value across every due tick. Workers::restart returned Failed before AdapterFactory::make; in the same fixture, the purported third recovery ended Up with restarts=4.
defects.reproduction: CM_CONF=/nonexistent/cm.conf cargo test --offline --locked --test audit_fin_edges rw02_tick_restarts_on_backoff_and_gives_up_after_five_attempts -- --ignored --nocapture; repeat with rw02_third_restart_recovers_before_failed_limit.
defects.note: The test is retained and ignored with the defect ID. Product code was not changed.
